page_title: WindowHop · Free Mac window switcher and AltTab alternative

summary.name: WindowHop
summary.one_liner: A free, open source, native macOS window switcher that lists individual windows instead of apps when you press ⌘Tab, positioned as an AltTab alternative.
use_cases: Switch between individual browser or document windows on a Mac
Find a window on another Space or display
Keep a window switcher open with ⌥Tab and navigate with arrow keys
Replace the default ⌘Tab app switcher with a per-window one
Install a Mac window switcher via Homebrew
summary.what_it_does: WindowHop replaces the Mac's ⌘Tab behavior so it lists windows rather than apps, with each window shown as its own tile. Pressing Tab or an arrow key moves the selection, and releasing Command switches to that exact window, including windows on other Spaces or displays. ⌥Tab opens a switcher that stays open. Minimized windows, hidden apps and Picture in Picture can optionally be included. Settings cover the visual style (following Light or Dark appearance), which windows to include, and which display the switcher opens on. It is derived from AltTab and is distributed as a signed, notarized disk image or via Homebrew.
notable: Lists windows instead of apps, so three browser windows appear as three tiles
Open source under GPL-3.0, derived from AltTab, with no telemetry or accounts
Shortcuts for both the standard switcher and a persistent ⌥Tab switcher are user-configurable
caveats: Requires macOS 26 or later and Apple Silicon Macs
Update checks are the only network activity, per the page
Small community footprint: page lists 224 downloads and 26 GitHub stars
